one_liner: Supabase has a free tier, a REST Management API with self-serve OAuth2 apps and per-project REST APIs, plus an official hosted MCP server.
auth_notes: Management API supports OAuth2 authorization-code flow; developers create OAuth Apps in org settings self-serve. Per-project data APIs use publishable/secret API keys (static secrets). PATs also exist for the Management API (not in snippets).
access_notes: Free plan with 2 active projects gives working API keys; OAuth app creation is in org settings. The partner program is optional (the catalog listing is free and needs no approval to build an integration).
blocker_notes: Free projects pause after a week of inactivity, which is minor.
